The '''Apiliria system''' was a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Apiliria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-5.<ref name="TEA" />
